messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: HIGH error-rate spike - eu-west-az4 serving tier (svc-infer-2). Alert ID: PD-87312. Trigger: 5xx_rate > 5% over 2m. page: @oncall-eng

olivia: seeing the PD page, checking dashboards

raj (sre): i can see ~12% 5xx from replicas in az4, connection reset / grpc: deadline

matt (oncall): acked via PD. on it. what's current capacity? :eyes:

incident-bot: Alert escalated to L2 after 3 mins (no ack). 

matt (oncall): ack. running quick health checks:
```
# check node statuses
kubectl get pods -n redwood-infer -o wide | grep az4
netstat -an | grep ESTABLISHED | wc -l
```

matt (oncall): several worker pods in eu-west-az4 are OOMKilled or in CrashLoopBackOff. GC spikes + increased tail latency. 

sara (support): customers reporting 503s for chat endpoints in eu-west. Incidents count 8, top customers: acme-corp, stellarlabs.

raj (sre): looks like a memory leak regression from yesterday's runtime patch. I've isolated a suspect commit: deploy-20260314-rt-fix. Rolling back candidate?

matt (oncall): start failover routing for az4 -> eu-west-az1 as per runbook (routing fallback). initiating redirect policy with rollout 100% for affected service.

matt (oncall): command run:
```
redwood-route set svc-infer-2 --region eu-west --from az4 --to az1 --policy fallback --force
```

incident-bot: Routing fallback activated for svc-infer-2: traffic diverted away from eu-west-az4. Estimated impact reduction in 30-60s.

olivia: confirm external metrics: latency back to normal on eu-west overall, but az4 pods still unhealthy. good to start evacuating workloads.

pagerduty: Alert PD-87312 acknowledged by matt (oncall) at 1767001302. Escalation suspended.

sara (support): posting customer-facing note draft:
"We're investigating elevated error rates affecting users in EU West (some sessions in eu-west-az4). We're diverting traffic and will update in 30m."

matt (oncall): tagging next oncall for handoff: @eric (oncall-next) please take over monitoring and coordinate rollback/patch. I'll stay for 10m to confirm stability then hand off.

eric (oncall-next): ack. will take over at 1767001600 UTC. prep steps?

matt (oncall): runbook steps done: diverted traffic, collected logs, snapshotted heapdumps to s3://redwood-incident-dumps/1767001234/. Next: attempt safe restart + rollback of deploy-20260314-rt-fix if crash resumes.

raj (sre): i'll prepare a rollback patch and healthcheck script. also increasing autoscaler thresholds to avoid thrash.

sara (support): update sent to affected customers and status page updated: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/PD-87312

olivia: adding severity tag P1 and assigning postmortem to @raj + @matt. timeline capture in progress.

matt (oncall): handing off: I'm leaving thread. @eric you own mitigation and updates. :white_check_mark:

eric (oncall-next): taking over. watching metrics now. will post timeline and final recovery ETA.

incident-bot: PD-87312 resolved (auto) after routing fallback stabilized and 3 consecutive clean windows. Closing alert at 1767001738.

eric (oncall-next): confirmed service restored for eu-west. az4 nodes still need cleanup; scheduling maintenance window with infra. tagging follow-up: #postmortem

olivia: thanks team. postmortem owners: raj, matt. support will coordinate customer follow-up.

sara (support): customers notified of mitigations and next steps. :thumbsup:
